dialogue.content: did half an hour standing up for no reason.
played through some old material with two other people. enjoyable.
compared two versions for far too long.
with anyone in earshot I only play what I already play well. I don't decide to — it just narrows to the safe material without me noticing.
even then. it's whether anyone can hear, not who.
tuned everything and then went to bed.
showed someone the thing I'm proud of. they nodded.
did it while something was on in the background.
put a new string on and broke it immediately.
had an evening alone going over things I already know.
spent longer choosing what to work on than working.
wrote the date on a thing so I'd remember when.
everything new that's ever entered my repertoire, I built alone. the group years polished what I already had and added not one new thing to it.
nothing new in all that time?
not one piece. very well-played old pieces, though.
restrung it and immediately put it down again.
watched a tutorial all the way through without trying any of it.
reorganised the shelf by colour. took an hour.
bought a thing I already own a version of.
cleaned everything instead of using any of it.
found a half-finished thing at the back of a drawer.
wrote down an idea and closed the notebook.
